facts.text: The hotel is tucked between the Kampong Glam, Little India and Bras Basah Bugis neighbourhoods.
facts.excerpt: Tucked between the colourful enclaves of Kampong Glam, Little India and Bras Basah Bugis

facts.text: Room and suite interiors are inspired by the traditional shophouses of the Kampong Glam neighbourhood.
facts.excerpt: feature interior décor inspired by the traditional shophouses in the Kampong Glam neighbourhood

facts.text: Rooms and suites have floor-to-ceiling windows framing views of the Singapore skyline.
facts.excerpt: Floor-to-ceiling windows flood spaces with natural light and frame the spectacular views of Singapore’s skyline from our luxurious rooms and suites

facts.text: Mr. Stork is a rooftop bar on level 39 with 360-degree city views and 10 teepee huts inspired by the nests of its namesake bird.
facts.excerpt: Nestled on the rooftop on level 39, Mr. Stork is an al fresco drinking and dining spot with 360-degree views of the city below. This sophisticated bar houses 10 teepee huts inspired by the nests built by its namesake bird

facts.text: The hotel was designed by Andre Fu.
facts.excerpt: The riches of this Andre Fu-designed hotel have to be sought out.

facts.text: The hotel lobby is on the 25th floor.
facts.excerpt: take the elevator to the 25th floor, where the hotel lobby is

facts.text: Room details channel the neighbourhood: mango yellow shophouse doors divide the bathroom from the sleeping area, echoing nearby heritage buildings.
facts.excerpt: the mango yellow shophouse doors that divided the bathroom from the sleeping area echoed the heritage buildings a stone’s throw away

facts.text: The bath products were created for the hotel by French perfumer Christophe Laudamiel.
facts.excerpt: The yummy bath products were created for the hotel by French perfumer, Christophe Laudamiel.

facts.text: Rooms have a complimentary minibar with snacks and non-alcoholic beverages.
facts.excerpt: Complimentary minibar with snacks and non-alcoholic beverages

facts.text: Guests have access to complimentary refreshments at the Sunroom.
facts.excerpt: Complimentary refreshments at Sunroom

facts.text: Deluxe sea view rooms look out to the coast of Singapore through floor-to-ceiling windows.
facts.excerpt: Wake up to stunning sea views of the coast of Singapore through floor-to-ceiling windows

facts.text: Heritage view rooms look over the historic landmarks of Kampong Glam.
facts.excerpt: views of historic landmarks of Kampong Glam

facts.text: The Presidential Suite has panoramic views of the Singapore skyline and South China Sea, a kitchenette and an entertainment room.
facts.excerpt: offering panoramic vistas of the Singapore skyline and South China Sea. This lavish suite includes a king bed, an expansive living room, a refined den, a fully equipped kitchenette, and an entertainment room

facts.text: Two-bedroom suites have two connecting rooms joined by a shared living area.
facts.excerpt: Two connecting rooms (each with a king bed) are seamlessly adjoined by a shared living area

facts.text: The hotel has an infinity pool.
facts.excerpt: Infinity Pool

facts.text: The fitness centre is open 24 hours.
facts.excerpt: 24-Hour Fitness Centre

facts.text: Alley on 25 is an all-day restaurant that recreates the experience of Singapore street dining in the sky.
facts.excerpt: Alley on 25 is a multi-cuisine, all-day restaurant that recreates in the sky the fluid and spontaneous experience of Singapore street dining

facts.text: 665°F on level 38 serves a meat-centric menu with Southeast Asian flavours.
facts.excerpt: Located on Level 38 of Andaz Singapore, 665°F features a meat-centric dining experience incorporating Southeast Asian flavours.

facts.text: Wu Yue Ting on level 25 serves Cantonese cuisine.
facts.excerpt: At level 25 of the hotel, Wu Yue Ting offers refined Cantonese cuisine

facts.text: Lifts near reception on level 25 lead down to Bugis MRT station (Exit E).
facts.excerpt: To access Bugis Bugis Mass Rapid Transit (MRT)​ Station (Exit E) on Basement 3, use the lifts near the reception on level 25.

facts.text: There is no complimentary car park access; the car park is managed by DUO Tower.
facts.excerpt: There is no complimentary carpark access as this facility is managed by DUO Tower.

facts.text: Pets are not allowed, except service animals.
facts.excerpt: Andaz Singapore does not allow pets with the exception of service animals.

facts.text: In-room and poolside dining serve Asian specialities, handcrafted pizzas and craft cocktails.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy Asian specialities, handcrafted pizzas and craft cocktails, all freshly made with premium and sustainable ingredients, from the comfort of your room or poolside.

facts.text: The rooftop bar overlooks the surrounding Kampong Glam neighbourhood.
facts.excerpt: There is a very cool rooftop bar overlooking the surrounding Arab-influenced Kampong Glam neighborhood with teepees that you can chill out in.
